rationale: Ground truth has no substantive concerns (just LGTM/approval), so both trivially achieve full recall. X digs deeper: it fully resolves the 'silent audio' claim into a concrete alternative failure mode (500 via pydantic tuple-extend bug) with a full evidence chain, whereas Y only hedges ('please verify... or rewrite'). X also catches a materially different, well-evidenced issue Y misses entirely — that the 'extra_body is not flattened' rule is stated too broadly and contradicts the GLM-Image recipe's working extra_body usage — plus adds two extra actionable, low-noise suggestions (index:0 collision fix, jq WAV-extraction snippet). Y's findings are grounded but shallower duplicates of X's weakest points, with less decisive conclusions.
